source.title: Downside risk and the performance of volatility-managed portfolios
author: Feifei Wang
Xuemin Sterling Yan

extracted_method.concept: Scale exposure by lagged downside volatility rather than lagged total volatility.
extracted_method.downside_definition_visible: Downside volatility is estimated from negative returns; related literature/current accessible text indicates a zero threshold.
extracted_method.motivation: High downside volatility may predict both high future volatility and lower future returns.
extracted_method.real_time_note: The paper reports improved real-time behavior from fixed-weight strategies versus repeatedly estimated weights.

blockers: Exact estimator horizon, normalization constant and fixed-weight real-time implementation needed for a faithful YATL specification are not fully exposed in accessible text.
